first_public_date_evidence: First arXiv posting of the chosen focal random-projected-cube/zonotope paper arXiv:0807.3590 on 2008-07-23; earlier historical articles are acknowledged but their first public calendar days were not verified.
scientific_integrity: All formulas are derived using a degenerate U-statistic decomposition, exact Fourier coefficients, and a uniform L2 tail bound. Numerical checks supplement proof; same-model review only; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Bounded independent radial noise and independent uniform planar directions only; pointwise asymptotic in exponent; no uniform rates or higher-dimensional theorem. Earlier circle-distance literature may include equivalent fixed-length marginal limit; the accepted assertion is the triangular radial-noise crossover, not that marginal. Historical priority provisional.
title: A critical radial-noise crossover for areas of random planar zonotopes
